title: AquaBEV: Monocular Underwater BEV Occupancy with 3D Sonar Supervision
description:
arXiv:2609.04411v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Autonomous underwater robots are widely used for exploration, monitoring, and inspection, where safe navigation depends on understanding the surrounding free and occupied space. Bird's eye view (BEV) occupancy provides such a representation, but predicting it from a single underwater RGB image is difficult due to limited, unreliable geometric cues from appearance alone. 3D imaging sonar offers complementary geometric measurements to supervise this
